```{=html}
<h1 class="h1">Machine Learning</h1>
<p class="role">ES 654 · IIT Gandhinagar · Semester II, 2021–22</p>
<p class="lede" style="margin-top:18px">ES 654 introduces machine learning: metrics, decision trees and ensembles, linear regression with gradient descent, ridge and lasso, Bayesian learning and logistic regression, neural networks and CNNs, naive Bayes, support vector machines and unsupervised learning. Every lecture links its slides, and most link a class recording.</p>
<dl class="facts">
  <dt>Instructor</dt><dd><a href="https://nipunbatra.github.io">Prof. Nipun Batra</a></dd>
  <dt>Email</dt><dd><a href="mailto:nipun.batra@iitgn.ac.in">nipun.batra@iitgn.ac.in</a></dd>
  <dt>Classes</dt><dd>Monday 10:05–11:00 am, Wednesday 9:05–10:00 am, Thursday 10:05–11:00 am</dd>
  <dt>Online</dt><dd><a href="https://iitgn-ac-in.zoom.us/j/96523429150">Zoom link</a></dd>
  <dt>Google Classroom</dt><dd>Code jclv62l</dd>
  <dt>Teaching assistants</dt><dd><a href="#people">4 TAs</a></dd>
  <dt>Prerequisites</dt><dd>Good experience in Python programming, probability and linear algebra</dd>
</dl>
```

```{=html}
<div class="two rule-top">
<section id="faq"><h2>Questions</h2>
<details class="q" id="grading"><summary>Where are the grading policy and the course FAQ?</summary><p>In the <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MXBjf61zCMC_WjkscGDxaX1EcHrAHDpYRIKaYsM2Adw/edit?usp=sharing">course FAQ and grading policy</a> document. You have comment access: comment on it to ask for more details.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="project"><summary>Where can I find project ideas?</summary><p>In the <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sX0YCbHTRPQ9kGPWyuFHIgjkqjbtQjLPsIxW6lUvO04/edit?usp=sharing">list of project ideas</a>. You have comment access: comment on it to ask the TAs for more details.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="prereqs"><summary>What are the prerequisites?</summary><p>Good experience in Python programming, probability and linear algebra.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="prepare"><summary>How do I prepare before the course?</summary><p>Refresh the prerequisites with the first four chapters of the <a href="https://jakevdp.github.io/PythonDataScienceHandbook/">Python Data Science Handbook</a>, <a href="https://machinelearningmastery.com/linear-algebra-machine-learning/">some material on linear algebra</a> and <a href="https://www.khanacademy.org/math/statistics-probability">Khan Academy's course on statistics and probability</a>.</p></details>
<details class="q" id="recordings"><summary>Where are the class recordings?</summary><p>Each lecture on the <a href="schedule.html">Lectures</a> page links its recording where one exists, and all of them are in a <a href="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xC6qiifQGrpoYb1-TVeMQmyYi2c9Nk7j?usp=sharing">Google Drive folder</a>. Spreadsheets used in class are in <a href="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Nr23dXUI-2sxr0YSuqa2tm9rbpM773uJ?usp=sharing">another folder</a>.</p></details>
</section>
```
